title: pDM阈值桥低负载NO逃逸的精确枚举
claim_scope: 有限观察；不是一般NO上界，也不是UM-TARGET-v1的困难性证明
limitations: The witness only attacks the naive inference that absence of a perfect matching forces a near-two NO value.
The pDM threshold theorem still proves the exact YES threshold and the integer lower bound OPT>=T+1 for every valid NO instance.
No statement about all possible gap amplifications or all R||Cmax algorithms is established.
